\caption[Declared per-tactic dwell parameters]{The dwell parameters the movement layer declares for each tactic. Panel~(a) gives the anchor families and the off-network null; panel~(b) the 15 tactics that resolve onto them, so the model carries 4 free timing parameters rather than 15. A tactic's dwell is its family's value scaled by the multiplier shown, and that dwell is the \emph{mean} of an exponential draw, $\mathrm{Exp}(\mu)$; resource development is the one exception, an immediate transition in the sense of Section~\ref{sec:petri-formalism} rather than a degenerate $\mathrm{Exp}(0)$. The evidence column reads: \emph{priced by MTDSim}, the value is the simulator's own action cost, inherited and not tuned; \emph{declared and swept}, a declared value whose robustness across its band is reported in Appendix~\ref{app:sensitivity}; \emph{declared, off-clock}, no in-simulator dwell at all. \emph{Priced from} names where a value's shape came from, which is not the action the tactic dispatches at run time --- for that mapping see Figure~\ref{fig:controller-mapping}. A drawn dwell \emph{replaces} the dispatched action's native cost rather than adding to it: an action consumes its tactic's drawn time and nothing further. Values are emitted from the declared catalogue (v0-uncalibrated); tactic names follow ATT\&CK~v19.1.}
